description.narrative: The project aims at reducing gender-based discrimination and violence against women and girls by: creating an enabling legislative and policy environment in line with international standards; promoting favorable social norms and attitudes and prevent discrimination and violence against women; and empowering women and girls (including women from minority groups) who have experienced discrimination or violence to advocate for and use available, accessible and quality services.
